title: Design: typing a price below cost shows a negative margin at once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $268.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with that inventory part on line 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the part's description.
  3. Type 199.00 in Sell Price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Part Request opens with category A and Cost 268.00.

Step 3:

  • Margin changes to -34.67 before saving: ($199.00 − $268.00) ÷ $199.00 = −34.67%.
  • The Sell Price box is outlined while typing, as in picture 11.2.
